questions.stem: The following are TYPE A adverse drug reactions except:
questions.solutionHtml:
Drug allergy

Type A or Augmented (Predictable) reaction

  • Mechanism-based adverse reaction
  • Side effects, Secondary effects toxic effects, drug withdrawal reactions

Type B or Bizarre (Unpredictable) reactions

  • Based on the peculiarities of the patient
  • Allergy
  • idiosyncrasy
  • Pharmacogenetics

Type C or chronic effects

  • antipsychotics induced Tardive dyskinesia
  • Cushing syndrome due to chronic use of Prednisolone

Type D or delayed effects

  • mutagenicity
  • secondary cancers induced by anti-cancer drugs
  • teratogenicity

Type E or end-of-treatment effects

  • Withdrawal effects like rebound hypertension after clonidine withdrawal


Essentials Of Medical Pharmacology, By KD Tripathi, 8th Edition, Page Number: 92

questions.stem: Which of the following is a category X drug:
questions.solutionHtml:
Warfarin

Warfarin is an oral anticoagulant that helps prevent the formation of harmful blood clots in the legs, lungs, brain, and heart.

questions.stem: A 57-year-old woman was stung by a swarm of wasps. She landed in casualty with breathlessness and swelling of her face, shoulder, and upper arm. Auscultation revealed bilateral crepitations and wheezing. Which of the following drug is used to treat this condition?

options.label: A
options.text: Adrenaline 0.5 mg (0.5 ml of 1 in 10000) i.m

options.label: B
options.text: Adrenaline 0.5 mg (0.5 ml of 1 in 1000) s.c

questions.solutionHtml:
Adrenaline 0.5mg (0.5 ml of 1 in 1000) i.m
  • Explanation: Adrenaline 0.5mg (0.5 ml of 1 in 1000) i.m is a life-saving drug for anaphylactic shock

questions.stem: Clonidine is a centrally-acting antihypertensive that can be successfully delivered transdermally. Clonidine patches are generally left in place for 7 days, which is a longer application period than is required by most other transdermal therapeutic systems (TTS) and may explain the relatively high incidence of allergic contact dermatitis from clonidine TTS. What type of allergic reaction is this?
questions.solutionHtml:
Type IV

questions.stem: A 25-year-old pregnant female in the first trimester came with complaints of morning sickness and she was prescribed a drug to treat her condition. When the patient delivered, the baby was born with a condition called Phocomelia. Which of the following drug is responsible for her condition?
questions.solutionHtml:
Thalidomide

Thalidomide is an oral medication used to treat several cancers (e.g. multiple myeloma), graft-versus-host disease, and many skin disorders (e.g. complications of leprosy such as skin lesions).
